_doc: What the learner is told to do, in the language the episode is in.
Keyed by ISO 639-3; the hand-written packs are reached by their own iso.
Every episode ends with this and it was English in all of them -- the
scene translated, the options translated, and then 'Answer with exactly
one of:' in English underneath. It is the one sentence a learner has to
act on rather than reason about.
{n}; a test asserts both, because a template quietly missing its
placeholder would drop the answer set from the prompt entirely.
Written by hand, and only for languages the wording could be checked in.
Everything else falls back to English, which is visible and honest; a
confidently ungrammatical instruction would not be.
